contradictions.claim_a: A clean verification requires deleting or resetting the entire dirty worktree.
contradictions.claim_b: Reproducibility can be proved without discarding source changes by using frozen lockfiles, generated-output rebuilds, packed candidates, and fresh temporary Cargo target directories.
contradictions.audit_trail: The package managers expose isolated/frozen mechanisms; deleting user-owned source changes is neither required nor safe.

contradictions.claim_a: Desktop tests plus packaged Kotlin and Swift sources certify mobile execution.
contradictions.claim_b: Only a target host invocation that returns through the Kotlin/Swift bridge certifies native mobile execution.
contradictions.audit_trail: Tauri explicitly states mock runtime does not execute native webview libraries and documents separate Kotlin/Swift plugin command paths.
